page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7t.4xlarge is a general-purpose server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 8 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It operates on the x86_64 architecture under a KVM hypervisor. Local storage is not bundled with this instance, and it lacks dedicated GPU hardware. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

The underlying Intel Xeon CPU includes hardware instruction support for AVX, AVX512F, and AVX512_VNNI, alongside cryptographic acceleration via AES, VAES, and SHA_NI. In performance testing, the instance achieved a single-core stress-ng CPU score of 1881.28 and a multi-core score of 15531.53. Geekbench testing yielded a single-core score of 1603.0 and a multi-core score of 9721.0, with specific workloads like software compilation with Clang scoring 15528.0 and ray tracing reaching 17644.0.

The memory subsystem delivers a cached read-only bandwidth of 846.65 GB/sec for small blocks, which drops to 97.84 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, and a write bandwidth of 57.96 GB/sec. The Passmark memory score is recorded at 2136.4. For application workloads, the instance handles 15.69 million Redis SET operations per second and achieves a static web serving throughput of 20.98 GB/sec. Large language model inference using a small 135M model reaches 1310.41 tokens/sec for prompt processing and 258.46 tokens/sec for text generation, while a medium 7B model processes prompts at 32.29 tokens/sec and generates text at 11.58 tokens/sec.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.g7t.4xlarge offers a stable resource profile for workloads requiring consistent compute and memory performance without the overhead of specialized hardware. The absence of local storage means storage-heavy operations must rely on external network-attached volumes, which represents a key architectural tradeoff. This instance is configured for general-purpose workloads, including web serving, database operations, software compilation, and light language model inference.
